items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got to play with Dizzy and a few other people, Coleman Hawkins.

ctx.x: I don’t know. I didn’t want to go nowhere, you know? Dizzy called me one time to come join him at Birdland. But it was paying such little money, man, that I couldn’t even take care of my money. It’d be better to stay home and be broke – be at home, broke.
Did you have a daughter by then?
